content:
issue_attested_bank_letter takes account_id and addressee and faithfully records the bank profile at issue time. A store review checks its required_addressee and that the letter age at the review result is no greater than letter_max_age_minutes.

It also compares the letter, bank and registry identity with the current entity and requires current registry/translation evidence. A registry revision becomes effective at its scheduled event and does not automatically update bank profiles, certificates or earlier evidence.

A later review can therefore require another identity epoch while the original intake remains valid.
